This year too we have camps ready for everyone who wants to improve their basic and advanced bike technique. Limited places depending on our instructors. Proven and new locations offered by the Říčany region and Central Bohemia.

We'll cover everything from body position on the bike, braking, descents, roots, trails and berms to riding over smaller obstacles you may encounter off-road.

For young riders we have a bike day camp in the Tehov leisure park and surrounding area.
